God-commissioned swift outstripper of chariots and overthrower of hosts: physically overwhelming passage overtakes racing chariots and topples long consecutive ranks

artistic_choices: Horse variant c01 exclusively; no Garuda/bird features or synthesized alternative.
Normal horse body size. A side-tracking view, natural directional motion blur and long continuous line of toppled host show extraordinary speed; no wings, aura or extra limbs/afterimages.
Overwhelming physical collision consequences stage c07 overthrower of hosts; no invented weather control or magic ground rupture.

rejected_attempts.reason: Reads as an ordinary bay war-horse among broken chariots — the 'ordinary animal' failure (same as the earlier Rain Bull rejection). Nothing shows the divine steed beyond normal size/speed. Use what the claims give (outstripping chariots, overthrowing hosts) at a scale or speed no real horse has; no Garuda/bird traits.

prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Tarkshya, the Rigvedic HORSE commissioned by the gods, the swift outstripper of chariots and overthrower of hosts. Show impossible speed and a whole host being physically overthrown, not an ordinary angry horse jumping wreckage.
ANATOMY: ONE sacred living horse, ONE head with two eyes, EXACTLY FOUR legs in a readable extended gallop, one mane and tail. Anatomically ordinary horse size and shape, no wings, bird beak, Garuda traits, horns, armor, rider or bridle. Deep burnished chestnut coat, completely natural horse anatomy [tarkshya-c01].
MOMENT: Outstrip an entire racing chariot host in a single devastating straight charge. CAMERA TRACKS ALONGSIDE the horse at ground level, three-quarter frontal side view: razor-sharp huge-in-perspective horse head, chest and ALL FOUR galloping legs occupy 70 percent of frame, hurtling diagonally from distant upper-left toward close lower-right. Mane and tail stream dead straight backward. One front hoof has JUST driven a wooden chariot axle sideways and disintegrated its wheel; wood pieces shoot backward while horse surges far beyond it. Horse's imposing focused expression is sacred victory, not demonic rage.
POWER: physically depict c07's extraordinary speed/outstripping chariots/overthrowing hosts at a scale no real horse could achieve. A VERY LONG UNBROKEN SEQUENCE of overturned chariots and recoiling fully clothed soldiers recedes behind it for dozens of ranks, progressively tipped over from the same devastating passage. Nearest two complete chariots with men are actively tumbling sideways through the air, wooden wheels and spars separating, directly in the horse's physical wake. Further ranks collapse like a line of dominoes into rolling dust, no gore. Off to the far upper edge a small normal-sized racing chariot with normal team horses strains unsuccessfully to keep up; tracking-camera panning stretches those background figures horizontally while Tarkshya remains sharp. Maintain real physical body sizes. The viewer must instantly read: this one horse has outpaced the entire host and smashed through rank after rank, NOT one normal bay horse among static wrecked chariots. [tarkshya-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low SIDE TRACKING camera at hoof height, wide-angle foreshortening, normal horse versus normal chariots/men; impossible SPEED not gigantic body. Horse is primary subject; long devastated host is secondary but unmistakable. Only ONE depiction of Tarkshya, no afterimage copies or extra legs.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low dying sun, sharp golden rim light on horse and splintering wheels; deep walnut shadows. Long dense physically kicked-up dust plume and directional blur convey prodigious speed. No aura, shockwave rings, energy trails, magical luminous dust, wind-control tornado or lightning.
SURFACE: sweat-dark horse coat, sharply textured mane at face stretching back from motion, dusty hooves, jagged actual wooden axles, spinning bronze wheel fittings.
SETTING: the long chariot-host field from the hymnic deed [tarkshya-c07], respectful early South Asian battle atmosphere, no temples, invented sacred symbols or inscriptions.
MOOD: overwhelming sacred divine victory through impossibly swift action, never cute, calm or a conventional war-horse portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoinscriptions, logo, frame, border or watermark; no extra heads or legs; no wings or Garuda features; no unsupported giant scale; no borrowed film/game/comic design; no nudity or gore; no generic magic glow, halo, neon or energy ribbons.
